source_notes: Re-pointed from third-party rehosts (mmerevise, theglc-gatewayacademy) of the June 2019 (Paper 1) and June 2017 (Paper 2) mark schemes to AQA's own June 2023 mark schemes, the oldest ones AQA still hosts. Structure confirmed identical: 6-level grids; Paper 1 Section A AO1/2/3/4 (12/12/6/4), Section B AO1/2/3 (12/12/6); Paper 2 Section A AO1/2/3/4 (12/12/6/4), Section B 30 marks, Section C Q1 (24) and Q2 (8). Criteria wording was drafted from the 2019/2017 versions and not re-compared line-by-line against 2023.

Added on rebuild (2026-09-22): confirmed against AQA's live subject-content pages that the current modern-texts list (checked 2026-09-22) has retired The History Boys, The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time and Never Let Me Go (each 'last exam 2024') and added Princess & The Hustler, Leave Taking and My Name is Leon (first exam 2025); the declared_exclusions list below reflects the current, non-retired option set, not the historic one. Confirmed the specification has no non-exam assessment or Spoken Language component (that endorsement belongs to English Language 8700, not English Literature 8702).
